message: To support Hong Kong Special Administrative Region 2026 Policy Address in promoting the development of Smart Port and the Port Community System, PCS will soon launch the "Offshore Trade-Cargo Tracking" function. For inquiries or assistance, please contact us at info.pcs@lscm.hk (email) or +852 3628 3699 (phone). 為配合香港特別行政區政府 2026年《施政報告》推動智慧港口及港口社區系統建設的發展方向，PCS即將推出「離岸貿易貨物追蹤」功能，如有查詢：可電郵至info.pcs@lscm.hk或致電 +852 3628 3699與我們聯絡。
